data.rationale: The Snowy Owl's exceptionally keen eyesight and silent, patient hunting style embody the 'Mindcensor' ability. Perched in its stark, open habitat, it meticulously scans its surroundings, effectively restricting the 'search' space for its prey to only the most exposed areas. Its ability to appear suddenly and silently (Flash), combined with its wise, watchful demeanor, fits the 'Bird Wizard' type perfectly.
